description: The EvoFox Deathray V2 Gaming Keyboard is the ultimate gaming Keyboard crafted for gamers who demand precision, style, and performance. This combo includes a feature-rich RGB Backlit Keyboard, designed to deliver an exceptional gaming experience. The keyboard features a 6-Zone Custom RGB Backlit Design with 8 Customizable Modes, 19 Anti-Ghosting Keys, and 10 Dedicated Multimedia Keys, allowing seamless control and responsiveness during intense gameplay. Unique shortcut keys like Screenshot, Show, and Xbox Game Bar add to its versatility, while the robust build quality and 1.8 m braided cable ensure durability and reliability. With the EvoFox Deathray V2 Gaming Keyboard, every keystroke, and every movement is optimized for victory. Game on with confidence and style! The Frost Cooling Pad comes with a Large Sturdy and Robust design that is suitable for Laptops upto 39.62 cm (15.6 inches). The Metal Mesh Design provides added Strength and cooling ability to the laptop and silicon pads ensure a stable grip on the surface. The EvoFox Frost laptop stand is provided with 5 adjustable Heights. Raising your laptop to eye level, helps keep your back straight and free from stiffness and pain.
